Order 
This writ petition has been filed for issue of writ of mandamus directing the 2nd respondent to re-determine the compensation awarded to the petitioner based on the application submitted by the petitioner under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 and based on the subsequent representation made on 06.06.2024.

2.Heard Mr.V.Rajesh Babu, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner and Mr.A.Tamilvanan, learned Additional Government Pleader (Puducherry) appearing on behalf of the respondents.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
3.The case of the petitioner is that he was the owner of the property and the lands were acquired under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
An Award was passed by the 3rd respondent dated 25.01.2008 in Award No.2 of 2008.
As against the same, some of the adjacent owners who also fell within the same Award went before the learned II Additional District Judge, Puducherry seeking for enhancement of compensation.
The learned II Additional District Judge through judgement dated 01.12.2018 enhanced the compensation.

Pursuant to the same, the petitioner submitted an application on 20.03.2019 under Section 28A of the Act seeking for re-determination of the compensation awarded to him based on the judgement in LAOP No.110 of 2012 passed by the learned II Additional District Judge, Puducherry.
Since the same was not acted upon, the present writ petition has been filed before this Court.

4.Taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of the case and considering the fact that on receipt of the application submitted by the petitioner under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act,
enquiry notice was also issued by the 3rd respondent in the year 2023 and thereafter, there has been no progress.

There shall be a direction to the 2nd respondent to conduct an enquiry and to pass an order https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis on its own merits and in accordance with law, within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
5.This writ petition is disposed of with the above directions.
No Costs.
